{{Top|leg}}
The '''liberation of the [[Drash-So labor camp]]''' happened at the end of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], when the [[Empire-in-exile]] freed the Sith prisoners on [[Drash-So]]. [[Imperial Knight]] [[Teemen Alton]] was one of the liberators, but came to suspect that the prisoner who called herself [[Ania Solo]] was [[Unidentified masked bounty hunter|not who she seemed]]. Alton went in pursuit of the individual after the liberation, and was killed by her in the nearby [[Opoku system]].
